## Professional summary

Applied AI engineer building enterprise retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-agent workflows, and multi-tenant AI applications in Python. At Maly Tech Ltd, contributed to the AI assistant for Deloitte Middle East's ME Tax Pulse and developed reusable customer-specific agent platforms. Public LangGraph/FastAPI repositories demonstrate backend architecture, authentication, persistence, MCP tool integration, and testing.

## Experience

### Maly Tech Ltd — Generative AI Engineer (Dubai, UAE | Aug 2024 - May 2026)

- Contributed to the AI assistant for Deloitte Middle East's ME Tax Pulse, implementing RAG/LangGraph workflows for ingestion, indexing, and retrieval across thousands of tax and legal documents.
- Built AI4ALL, a multi-tenant platform for customer-specific AI agents and prototypes using Python, Google ADK, agent orchestration, and tool calling; reduced prototype delivery from days or weeks to hours.
- Developed Luna, a RAG-powered financial assistant using prompt engineering and context injection; associated with a reported 60% reduction in routine customer-support tickets.

### Freelance — Software Developer (Oct 2023 - Aug 2024)

- Developed and maintained web applications with Angular, Laravel, and REST APIs, integrating backend services and building reusable UI components.
